description: This file defines a template class 'CompressedTuple' that implements an optimized tuple using Empty Base Optimization (EBO). It includes internal storage mechanisms for empty and non-empty types, and provides member access functions. The file is part of the Abseil C++ library, specifically within internal container utilities.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::CompressedTuple
classes.description: A tuple class optimized with Empty Base Optimization for empty types.
